ICD-10-PCS Definitions

Source: R/definition.R
definition.Rd

ICD-10-PCS Definitions

Usage

definition(section = NULL, axis = NULL, term = NULL)

includes(section = NULL, axis = NULL, term = NULL)

Arguments

section

<chr> PCS section; one of 0:9, B, C, F, G, H, X

  • Operation: 0:9, X

  • Approach: 0:4, 7:9, X

  • Type: B, C, F, G, H

  • Type Qualifier: F

  • Qualifier: G

axis

<int> PCS axis; one of 3, 4, 5

  • 3: Operation (91) | Type (46)

  • 4: Qualifier (15)

  • 5: Approach (39) | Type Qualifier (129)

term

<chr> term to search for

Value

a tibble::tibble containing the results

Examples

try(definition(term = "drinnn"))
#> Error in definition(term = "drinnn") : 
#>   term = "drinnn" returned 0 rows
definition(term = "drain")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   entry section  axis name      term     definition                             
#>   <int> <chr>   <int> <chr>     <chr>    <chr>                                  
#> 1    10 0           3 Operation Drainage Taking or letting out fluids and/or ga…
#> 2   518 1           3 Operation Drainage Taking or letting out fluids and/or ga…
definition(section = "0", axis = 5)
